designs.title: Telegram check (for the Lenovo)

designs.title: Record a debt r8 (approved 11 Nov)

designs.title: Record a debt: keyboard and button test
designs.what: Type an amount, a number, a name. Does Telegram's button sit right above the keyboard? Try Back with a card open.
